# Decoupled_Priors

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-07-30

## Definition
A mechanism in which prior probability distributions are separated from the sensory data stream, allowing independent manipulation or contestation within a topology-centric computing fabric. Enables topology-aware routing of belief states across network nodes, critical for distributed inference and memory consolidation in TCC architectures.
